name: Unfamiliar
source:
Unfamiliar is a visual novel/click-through game that attempts to show the affects Alzheimer's on a family.

[From [url=https://kovakomes.itch.io/unfamiliar] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Unfamiliar》是一款視覺小說／點擊式遊戲，試圖展現阿茲海默症對一個家庭造成的影響。

（來源：[url=https://kovakomes.itch.io/unfamiliar]itch.io[/url]）
